archive_policy.reason: The manufacturer and standards material is copyrighted. This repository records canonical URLs, document versions where exposed, scoped claims, and access status without redistributing source diagrams or manuals.
archive_policy.mutable_web_warning: Dell online-manual topics can redirect by locale or product alias. A URL remaining reachable does not prove its content is unchanged; revalidation must compare the scoped claim and product context.
